How AI-Powered Playable Worlds Are Reinventing Storytelling
By Devin Becker   •   November 17, 2026
AI roleplay has been evolving beyond chatbots into persistent, interactive worlds where players can explore stories, build relationships, and shape what happens next. Host
Devin Becker
is joined by
Jin Oh
, Partner at Goodwater Capital, to discuss why Goodwater backed WRTN and what makes AI-powered “playable worlds” an emerging category worth watching. Jin explains why AI roleplay can drive unusually high engagement, how replacing the traditional human Dungeon Master with AI changes interactive storytelling, and why the strongest worlds are still largely human-authored despite falling creation costs. The conversation also explores what cheaper world-building means for creators, how monetization and safety concerns may shape the category, why Korea and Japan have taken an early lead, and what needs to happen for playable worlds to become a larger opportunity for game studios, creators, and major IP holders over the next several years.
